Screenshot of resolutions from minutes:

MOVED by Councillor Andrew Baker, seconded by Councillor Sarah Paterson-
Hamlin:
That the Transport and Infrastructure Delivery Committee:
a. approve / whakaae the Council Group submission on the Proposed time of use charging regulations under the Land Transport Management (Time of Use Charging) Act 2025 as circulated prior to the meeting and summarised in paragraph 15 of the report:
vii. recommend the penalty fee has an annual review mechanism.
viii. recommend the penalty fee mechanism allows for alternative pricing frameworks.
ix. recommend the regulations allow for recovery of debt collection costs.
x. recommend an assessment of the impact of the penalty fee on Māori
and low-income households, and people with disabilities is conducted
before the review is finalised.

The motion was put to the vote by a show of hands and was declared LOST by 12 to 7 votes.

LOST

post.text:
Then we got to the weirdest vote, part 3, which was vii (7) to x(10).  

No one asked for 10 to be done alone.  

I don't recall any issues being raised about 7, 8, 9.

7 - review the penalty fee annually
8 - allow for alternative pricing frameworks
9 - ensure debt collection costs included..
